name: VehicleOrderBankTracker
tagline: Every new-vehicle order from signature to handover – allocation, build week, VIN, ETA slips and customer updates in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete order-bank app for dealers and dealer groups: a pipeline from Ordered to Delivered with OEM allocation, build-week, VIN, arrival and handover rules; an ETA planner by arrival week where an order is dragged to a new week with a reason while the first promised ETA is kept; a customer-update queue with messages generated for each order's status; and an order register with bulk ETA moves, deposits against policy and balance checks before the handover. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, a model-driven form or dashboard, or a Power Pages page.
features: 10 KPI tiles: open orders, order-bank value, deposits held, in production, in transit, at dealer, ETA passed, ETA slipped, updates due, order-to-handover days, on-time arrival
Pipeline with drag and drop and rule-checked steps: Allocate, Schedule build, Start production, Shipped, Arrived, Hand over
OEM order number, minimum deposit %, ISO build week, 17-character VIN check, balance paid before handover
ETA planner by arrival week with drag-to-week ETA changes, reasons, slip vs first promise and bulk moves
Customer-update queue with template messages, channel logging and CustomerMessage output for Outlook / Power Automate
Order bank grid: search, sort, group, bulk status / ETA / update / assign / export / delete with Undo
Stock, fleet and demonstrator orders next to customer orders
Phone layout with bottom navigation, column switcher and full-screen detail
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
